label: D2 after choosing a2 and landing in S1 (rare a2->S1 transition)
explanation: Fires only at D2 (100% of mass), and there only when the last-action input is a2 and the state input is S1, i.e. the specific rare transition a2->S1. Uses only inputs observed at D2. It does not fire at D1 or GO, on a1->S1 common transitions (0.6% of mass, weak), or on any S2 arrivals. Adding prev_action == 2 cuts recall (F1 0.82), so the feature is not specific to a repeated a2 choice. Dev F1 0.93, mass recall 0.99. Activation is near-saturated (median 4.6 of max 5.6). Weaker activations and the ~9% false positives occur on some a2->S1R steps that depend on recent history (e.g. recent a1 trials or recent rare S1 visits). I did not characterize this precisely, so I make no strong magnitude claim.

issues: The core claims check out. On dev, D2 holds 100% of activation mass (GO has 1 active step, D1 has 0). in_state==2 has 8 active steps. a1->S1 (in_action==1 & in_state==1 at D2) gives recall 0.049 but mass recall only 0.006, all in the lowest activation quartile. Adding prev_action==2 drops F1 to 0.82. Original test scores reproduce: P 0.909, R 0.945, F1 0.926, mass recall 0.992.

The explanation gets the false positives wrong. It says the ~9% FPs 'depend on recent history, for example recent a1 trials or recent rare S1 visits'. That is not supported: precision of the predicate stays at 0.87-0.94 when split by prev_state, prev_reward, prev_action, two-back states, good state or since_rev, so history does not separate them.

The FPs are systematic, and the cause is position in the episode (ep_trial). Precision of the predicate is 0.9999 for ep_trial<50, 0.9995 for 50-79 and 0.933 for 80-89, then falls to 0.41 for 90-93, 0.014 for 94-96 and 0.000 for 97+. Near the end of the episode the feature switches off on rare a2->S1 arrivals. The model's value head shows the same thing: every predicate-true step with value<4 is in ep_bucket 5. Bins with value<3.6 have precision 0.0, and value>=5 has precision 0.993.
The weak a1->S1c misses (activation about 0.01-0.27 of max) tend to come shortly after an a2->S1 rare trial. That is a small residual (0.6% of mass) and does not change the label.
ep_trial is not a future random outcome. A recurrent agent can track elapsed time, and its value output shows that it does. So the refined predicate uses no unobservable variable.
The label slightly overclaims by implying the feature fires on every rare a2->S1 arrival. It is suppressed in the last ~10 trials of the 100-trial episode.
